title: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
summary: Governance frameworks, risk management and compliance programmes.
definition: We help organisations set up the governance, risk management and compliance arrangements that let leadership see what is required, who is responsible and how well it is working.
covers: Risk management frameworks, registers and risk appetite
Policy and procedure development and review
Mapping of regulatory and legal obligations
Compliance monitoring and reporting to leadership
howWeWork: Map the obligations, decision-makers and existing arrangements that apply to you.
Find gaps in ownership, policy coverage and risk visibility.
Define a proportionate framework with clear roles, policies and reporting.
Support your team in adopting the framework and using it in day-to-day work.
Set review cycles and reporting so the framework keeps pace with change.
ctaTitle: Discuss your governance, risk and compliance requirements

title: ISO & Compliance Readiness
summary: Preparation for ISO 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and related standards.
definition: We prepare organisations for management-system standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001. Our role is advisory: we help you get ready, and an independent certification body carries out the assessment and issues any certificate.
covers: Gap assessment against the requirements of the standard
Control selection and the statement of applicability
Readiness support ahead of an external assessment
howWeWork: Establish the scope, context and where you stand against the standard.
List the gaps and the risks your management system must address.
Design the policies, processes and records the standard requires.
Help your team operate the system and generate the evidence it produces.
Run internal review and management review, and act on the findings.

title: Data Protection & Privacy
summary: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 obligations and privacy programmes.
definition: We help organisations meet their obligations under UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, and build privacy practices that people can follow in their daily work.
covers: Data mapping and records of processing
Lawful basis and privacy notice review
Personal data breach response and notification
howWeWork: Establish what personal data you hold, where it flows and why.
Identify where practice differs from the law and from your own notices.
Design records, notices, procedures and assessments that fit your operations.
Support rollout to the teams that handle the data.
Review changes in processing and keep records and notices current.

title: AI Governance & Responsible AI
summary: Governance over how AI is selected, implemented, used and monitored.
definition: We help organisations put governance around AI: how it is selected, implemented, used and monitored, and who is accountable for it at each stage.
covers: Inventory of AI use and classification by risk
AI governance policy and lines of accountability
Responsible AI principles turned into working controls
Alignment with ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI RMF
Data protection considerations in AI use
howWeWork: Find out where AI is already used or planned across the organisation.
Identify the risks, obligations and gaps in oversight for each use.
Design policy, approval routes and controls proportionate to the risk.
Help teams apply the controls when they select and deploy AI.
Monitor use and revisit governance as the technology and rules develop.

title: Cybersecurity Governance & Vulnerability Management
summary: Cybersecurity governance and vulnerability management programmes.
definition: We help organisations govern cybersecurity and manage vulnerabilities as an ongoing programme, with clear ownership and reporting to leadership.
covers: Design of the vulnerability management process
Scoping and commissioning of scans and penetration tests, and follow-up of findings
Standards for access control and secure configuration
Security measures and reporting to leadership
howWeWork: Understand your systems, data and the threats and obligations that apply.
Identify weaknesses in governance, process and technical exposure.
Design policy, ownership and a workable vulnerability handling process.
Support your teams in running the process and acting on findings.
Report on progress and adjust priorities as your exposure changes.

title: Technology Risk & IT Controls
summary: Technology risk assessment and the IT controls that manage it.
definition: We help organisations understand the risks that come with the technology they run and rely on, and design the IT controls that manage those risks.
covers: Design of IT general controls: access, change, operations and backup
Approach to testing that controls operate
howWeWork: Map the systems, suppliers and processes your organisation depends on.
Identify where technology risk is unmanaged or unowned.
Design controls with clear owners and evidence of operation.
Help teams adopt the controls and record that they operate.
Test controls periodically and track remediation to closure.

title: SOC 2 & Controls Readiness
summary: Preparing your controls and evidence for a SOC 2 assessment.
definition: We help service organisations prepare their controls and evidence for a SOC 2 examination. An independent audit firm carries out the examination and issues the report; our role is readiness.
covers: Scoping against the Trust Services Criteria
Approach to collecting and organising evidence
Policy set covering the applicable criteria
howWeWork: Agree the scope, the criteria and the systems in the examination.
Compare your current controls with what the criteria expect.
Design missing controls and document those that already exist.
Help teams operate controls and capture evidence as they go.
Review results and keep controls effective through the reporting period.

title: Audit, Assurance & Regulatory Readiness
summary: Support with audits, assurance activity and regulatory readiness.
definition: We help organisations prepare for audits and regulatory engagement, and build the assurance activity that shows controls are working between them.
covers: Assurance mapping across regulatory and framework requirements
Monitoring of regulatory change and its impact
howWeWork: Establish what will be examined, by whom and against which requirements.
Identify weaknesses in evidence, ownership or control operation.
Design an assurance plan and organise the documentation it needs.
Support your team through the audit or regulatory engagement.
Track findings to closure and feed lessons back into your controls.
ctaTitle: Discuss your audit and assurance requirements
